seo.title: Fill & Sign PDF — Fill Forms and Add Your Signature | JPdf
seo.description: Fill in a PDF's form fields and add a drawn or uploaded signature, entirely in your browser. Free, fast, and private.

subtitle: Fill in form fields and sign a PDF with a drawn or uploaded signature.

howItWorks.title: How to fill and sign a PDF
steps: Upload the PDF you want to fill in or sign.
Type directly into any detected form fields, or use the text and drawing tools to fill in and sign the document by hand.
Click Export to download the completed, signed PDF.

editor.overlayNote: Your signature is added as a visual mark on the page, not a cryptographic digital signature — it won't carry the identity verification or tamper-evidence a certificate-based e-signature provides.

items.q: Is this a legally-binding digital signature?
items.a: No. This creates a visual signature — a drawn or image mark placed on the page, the same as signing a printed page and scanning it. It does not create a cryptographically verifiable digital signature (the kind backed by a certificate), which is a separate, more involved capability this tool doesn't provide.

items.q: Does this work on any PDF?
items.a: Signature placement works on any PDF. Automatic form-field detection only applies if the PDF already has real fillable fields built in — otherwise, use the text tool to type values anywhere on the page, just like filling out a paper form.

items.q: Can I draw my signature with a mouse or trackpad?
items.a: Yes — choose the drawing tool and draw directly on the page. You can also upload an image of your signature instead.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Your file is uploaded securely as soon as you select it, so it's ready to process; the changes you draw stay in your browser until you click Export, and are then applied on our servers. Uploaded files and results are automatically deleted after a short retention period.
